Figure 1. HPLC analysis (320 nm) of polyketides synthesized by (A) PKS4,
(B) PKS4 S1830A mutant, (C) PKS4-99, (D) PKS4 S1830A mutant
complemented with PKS4 standalone TE/CLC domain, and (E) PKS4-99
complemented with TE/CLC domain. Final concentrations for the me-
gasynthases and TE/CLC are 20 and 40 µM, respectively.

Figure 2. (A) Authentic standards of 3, 5, and 6. HPLC analysis (280
nm) of polyketides synthesized by (B) PKS4, (C) PKS4 and act KR, and
(D) PKS4, Gris ARO/CYC, and OxyN. Final concentrations for the
megasynthases and bacterial enzymes are 20 and 40 µM, respectively.
